schema_note: rms_details live primarily on each paper in papers-data.json. This mirror is bibcode -> entries for inspection/tools. Top-level metrics.rms binary flags are unchanged.

1994A&AS..108..585S.title: Multi-frequency synthesis techniques in radio interferometric imaging

rms_details.scope: Blank regions of final multi-frequency CLEAN image (PKSB1733-565)
rms_details.evidence: Blank regions have rms about 1.5× the stated 60 μJy/beam thermal-noise limit (≈90 μJy/beam). Remaining local errors near the core/hot spot are discussed; no single measured DR ratio for the final image.

2008A&A...487..419B.title: Correcting direction-dependent gains in the deconvolution of radio interferometric images

rms_details.scope: Simulated Stokes V with squint+pointing correction (Figure 4)
rms_details.evidence: Figure 4 reports off-source RMS of 10 μJy/beam without squint and pointing correction and 1 μJy/beam with both corrections.

rms_details.scope: Real IC2233 Stokes V residual after A-projection correction

execution_context.image_region: Full residual (Stokes V; extrema no longer source-correlated)

rms_details.evidence: After time-varying primary-beam and polarization-squint correction, Stokes V residual extrema were about ±0.5 mJy/beam and the RMS was 0.15 mJy/beam, slightly above expected thermal noise (~0.13 mJy/beam).

rms_details.scope: Simulated polarization-squint / pointing correction vs uncorrected

execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Simulation (and order-of-magnitude claim on real data)

rms_details.evidence: Simulated Stokes V RMS falls from ~2 mJy peak / 10 μJy/beam RMS to noise-like ~1 μJy/beam (factor ≈10). Paper also characterizes systematic-error reduction as one order of magnitude on real data.

2008ISTSP...2..793C.title: Multiscale CLEAN Deconvolution of Radio Synthesis Images

rms_details.scope: M31 VLA C-array simulation Table II (Multiscale CLEAN)

execution_context.image_region: Full error image vs clean-beam-smoothed truth

rms_details.evidence: Table II image-domain RMS error: Högbom 8.8, Clark 25.6, Multi-Resolution 14.7, Multiscale CLEAN 4.9, maximum entropy 2.5 mJy/beam. Multiscale lowest among CLEAN-family methods. Peak/off-source RMS used only to define DR in other sweeps is not counted as a standalone RMS subtype here.

rms_details.scope: M31 Table II RMS error comparison
rms_details.evidence: Multiscale CLEAN's 4.9 mJy/beam RMS error is lower than Högbom (8.8), Multi-Resolution (14.7), and Clark (25.6); maximum entropy is lower still (2.5).

2011A&A...532A..71R.title: A multi-scale multi-frequency deconvolution algorithm for synthesis imaging in radio interferometry

rms_details.scope: M87 L-band restored image (3 arcsec; C+B config)
rms_details.evidence: Central restored image peaked at 15 Jy, with 1.8 mJy off-source RMS and 3–10 mJy on-source RMS.

rms_details.scope: 3C286 EVLA wideband test — RMS near source and 1° away
rms_details.evidence: Raising Taylor terms from one to four reduced RMS near 3C286 through 9 mJy, 1 mJy, 200 μJy, and 140 μJy; RMS 1° away was 1 mJy, 200 μJy, 85 μJy, and 80 μJy vs ~70 μJy thermal estimate.

rms_details.scope: 3C286 RMS vs fewer Taylor terms
rms_details.evidence: Near-source and off-source residual RMS fall by orders of magnitude as Taylor terms increase from 1 to 4 (numerical comparison across configurations).

2014MNRAS.444..606O.title: WSClean: an implementation of a fast, generic wide-field imager for radio astronomy

rms_details.scope: MWA 100-source simulation, zenith, 12 w-layers (WSClean)
rms_details.evidence: At zenith with 12 w-layers/planes, WSClean reports 0.94 mJy/beam residual RMS vs CASA 1.90 mJy/beam; other zenith/plane settings tabulated similarly (e.g. 0.90–1.07 mJy/beam at 10° zenith angle).

rms_details.scope: WSClean vs CASA residual RMS on controlled MWA sims
rms_details.evidence: Across tests, WSClean summarized as having 0–49% lower residual RMS than CASA (e.g. 0.94 vs 1.90 mJy/beam at 12 planes). Authors caution equal plane counts can disadvantage CASA at zenith.

rms_details.unit: % lower residual RMS (upper end of stated range)
rms_details.scope: WSClean vs CASA summary across controlled tests
rms_details.evidence: Paper summarizes WSClean as 0–49% lower residual RMS than CASA across the controlled accuracy benchmarks.

2017MNRAS.471..301O.title: An optimized algorithm for multi-scale wideband deconvolution of radio astronomical images

rms_details.scope: Real MWA Vela/Puppis A field (WSClean scale-bias 0.60)
rms_details.evidence: Default CASA multi-scale CLEAN 64 mJy/PSF residual RMS; WSClean bias 0.60 gives 50 mJy/PSF. Masked cleaning reduces residual RMS from 50 to 38 mJy/PSF (near 36 mJy/PSF Stokes V system-noise estimate). LOFAR imperfect-data run reaches 1.4 mJy/PSF RMS (WSClean MF multi-scale).

rms_details.scope: Wideband MWA simulation — multi-frequency multi-scale CLEAN

execution_context.residual_vs_dirty: Residual (vs dirty RMS for reduction factor)

rms_details.evidence: Figure 10 off-source residual RMS: 880, 310, 2000, 460, and 63 μJy/PSF for single-scale, multi-scale, MORESANE, MF single-scale, and MF multi-scale CLEAN. Masked MF multi-scale reaches 55 μJy/PSF.

rms_details.scope: Wideband MWA simulation dirty-image RMS (reference for reduction factor)
rms_details.evidence: Dirty-image RMS quoted as 280 mJy/PSF; MF multi-scale residual 63–64 μJy/PSF is described as a factor of ~4400 below that dirty RMS (masked: factor ~5100).

rms_details.scope: Real MWA Vela/Puppis A residual RMS
rms_details.evidence: WSClean 50 mJy/PSF vs CASA 64 mJy/PSF (and IUWT/MORESANE 63/75). Authors caution scale-bias/gridder differences; text/figure discrepancy on one WSClean setting (47 vs 62 mJy/PSF) unresolved.

rms_details.scope: Wideband sim MF multi-scale residual vs dirty RMS

execution_context.residual_vs_dirty: Residual vs dirty (scalar factor; not ‖r̂‖₂/‖x_dirty‖₂ RDR)

rms_details.evidence: MF multi-scale residual ~63–64 μJy/PSF called a factor of 4400 below 280 mJy/PSF dirty RMS; with automatic masking 55 μJy/PSF → factor ~5100. Treated as absolute RMS reduction vs dirty, not R2D2-style normalised RDR.

2018A&A...616A..27V.title: Image Domain Gridding: a fast method for convolutional resampling of visibilities

rms_details.scope: Source-box residual image (IDG vs classical gridding)

execution_context.image_region: Source box and full residual image

rms_details.evidence: Source-box residual RMS: IDG 7.6e-6 vs classical 1.3e-4 Jy/beam (~19× lower). Full residual image: 1.1e-6 vs 2.1e-5 Jy/beam (~17× lower). Visibility-domain RMS and PSF-sidelobe RMS are not counted as residual-image RMS subtypes.

rms_details.scope: Out-of-field-source dirty-image RMS comparison
rms_details.evidence: Dirty-image RMS for a simulated out-of-field source reported 2% lower with IDG. Figure 8 caption absolute values are internally inconsistent with the 2% claim; percentage retained, absolute caption values not trusted without erratum.

rms_details.scope: IDG vs classical gridding residual RMS
rms_details.evidence: Text summarizes residual-noise reduction as roughly a factor of 18 (~17× full image, ~19× source box).

rms_details.scope: Out-of-field-source suppression
rms_details.evidence: Out-of-field dirty-image RMS reported 2% lower with IDG than classical gridding.

2025arXiv251213591C.title: astroCAMP: A Community Benchmark and Co-Design Framework for Sustainable SKA-Scale Radio Imaging

rms_details.scope: astroCAMP Table 2 core fidelity metric (not tabulated in §6 runs)

execution_context.residual_vs_dirty: Dirty (σ_dirty); residual RMS appears only inside DR = I_max/σ_res
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Framework definition (WSClean+IDG matrix does not tabulate RMS values)

rms_details.evidence: Defines dirty-image RMS σ_dirty = sqrt((1/N) Σ (I_i − Ī)²) as a core quality metric and uses it in the example quality tuple. Section 6 does not tabulate those RMS values. Residual RMS as DR denominator alone is not a separate measured RMS subtype here.

2023MNRAS.522.5558W.title: Scalable precision wide-field imaging in radio interferometry: I. uSARA validated on ASKAP data

rms_details.scope: ASKAP real-data fields (Abell 3395 / PKS 2014-55 / Dancing Ghosts)

execution_context.image_region: Residual map (contours at multiples of residual rms)
execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Real ASKAP Early Science / Pilot data

rms_details.evidence: Reports measured residual-map rms as fidelity/sensitivity context: e.g. WSClean ~1–2 μJy/pixel, 1.6 μJy/pixel (PKS 2014-55), and 1 μJy/pixel (Dancing Ghosts). Source boundaries drawn at multiples of residual rms vs calculated image-noise std. Not a normalised RDR score.

2024ApJ...966L..34D.title: CLEANing Cygnus A Deep and Fast with R2D2

rms_details.scope: Cygnus A deep imaging method comparison
rms_details.evidence: Primary quantitative fidelity metric: std. dev. of the residual dirty image — Hö-CLEAN 359×10⁻⁴; CS-CLEAN 8.6×10⁻⁴; MS-CLEAN 10.4×10⁻⁴; R2D2 11.7×10⁻⁴; R2D2-Net 13.4×10⁻⁴; R3D3 9.7×10⁻⁴; uSARA 7.2×10⁻⁴; AIRI 7.4×10⁻⁴.

rms_details.scope: Residual std across CLEAN / R2D2 / uSARA / AIRI
rms_details.baseline: CLEAN-family and other reconstructors in same table
rms_details.evidence: AIRI, uSARA, and CS-CLEAN achieve the lowest residual std; R2D2 variants are described as comparable, slightly above those top performers (numerical table).

2025MNRAS.543.1727L.title: MROP: modulated rank-one projections for compressive radio interferometric imaging

rms_details.scope: Real VLA 3C 273 X-band (D/N ≈ 0.98)

execution_context.simulation_vs_real: Real VLA data (also used as sim diagnostic)

rms_details.evidence: Residual dirty image and its standard deviation used as data-fidelity diagnostic. Real-data residual-map std: classical 6.49×10⁻⁴; MROP 6.87×10⁻⁴ (highly comparable at high compression).

rms_details.scope: MROP vs classical residual-map std (3C 273)
rms_details.evidence: MROP residual-map std 6.87×10⁻⁴ vs classical 6.49×10⁻⁴ — numerical comparison confirming fidelity preserved under compression.
